		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "atm_window"
		visible = {
			has_country_flag = atm_gui_open
		}
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		effects = {
			atm_close_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					atm_close_window = yes
				}
			}
			atm_on_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_on = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_on = 0 } }
					else = { set_variable = { atm_on = 1 } }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_on = 1 } } atm_run_apply = yes }
				}
			}
			atm_dry_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_dry = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_dry = 0 } }
					else = { set_variable = { atm_dry = 1 } }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_run_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					atm_run_apply = yes
				}
			}
			atm_tab1_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					set_variable = { atm_tab = 1 }
					clr_country_flag = atm_reset_armed

					set_variable = { atm_tab = 4 }

	atm_tab4_gui = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "atm_tab4"
		parent_window_name = "atm_window"
		visible = {
			has_country_flag = atm_gui_open
			check_variable = { atm_tab = 4 }
		}
		dirty = ROOT.atm_list_rev
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		effects = {
			atm_filter_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_filter = 1 }
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_filter > 2 } } set_variable = { atm_filter = 0 } }
					atm_build_list = yes
				}
			}
			atm_refresh_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					atm_recompute_scores = yes
					atm_build_list = yes
				}
			}

					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_partial = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_partial = 2 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_partial = 2 } } set_variable = { atm_partial = 2 } }
					else = { set_variable = { atm_partial = 1 } }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_partial_min_dec_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_partial_min = -5 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_partial_min min = 10 max = 100 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_partial_min_dec_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_partial_min = -25 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_partial_min min = 10 max = 100 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_partial_min_inc_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_partial_min = 5 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_partial_min min = 10 max = 100 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_partial_min_inc_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_partial_min = 25 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_partial_min min = 10 max = 100 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_budget_mode_dec_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 0 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 0 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 2 } } set_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 1 } }
					else = { set_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 0 } }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_budget_mode_inc_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 1 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 2 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 2 } } set_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 2 } }
					else = { set_variable = { atm_budget_mode = 0 } }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_budget_val_dec_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_budget_val = -1 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_budget_val min = 0 max = 999 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_budget_val_dec_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_budget_val = -10 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_budget_val min = 0 max = 999 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_budget_val_inc_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_budget_val = 1 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_budget_val min = 0 max = 999 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_budget_val_inc_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_budget_val = 10 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_budget_val min = 0 max = 999 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_block_days_dec_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_block_days = -1 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_block_days min = 1 max = 60 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_block_days_dec_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_block_days = -5 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_block_days min = 1 max = 60 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_block_days_inc_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_block_days = 1 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_block_days min = 1 max = 60 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_block_days_inc_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_block_days = 5 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_block_days min = 1 max = 60 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_min_eff_dec_click = {

					add_to_variable = { atm_min_eff = -5 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_min_eff min = 0 max = 100 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_min_eff_dec_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_min_eff = -25 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_min_eff min = 0 max = 100 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_min_eff_inc_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_min_eff = 5 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_min_eff min = 0 max = 100 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_min_eff_inc_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_min_eff = 25 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_min_eff min = 0 max = 100 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_cooldown_dec_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_cooldown = -1 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_cooldown min = 1 max = 30 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_cooldown_dec_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_cooldown = -5 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_cooldown min = 1 max = 30 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_cooldown_inc_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_cooldown = 1 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_cooldown min = 1 max = 30 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_cooldown_inc_shift_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					add_to_variable = { atm_cooldown = 5 }
					clamp_variable = { var = atm_cooldown min = 1 max = 30 }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_rebalance_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_rebalance = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_rebalance = 1 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_rebalance = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_rebalance = 0 } }
					else = { set_variable = { atm_rebalance = 1 } }
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
			atm_reset_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { has_country_flag = atm_reset_armed } clr_country_flag = atm_reset_armed atm_run_reset = yes }
					else = { set_country_flag = atm_reset_armed }
				}
			}
			atm_defaults_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					atm_set_defaults = yes
					atm_settings_changed = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	atm_tab6_gui = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "atm_tab6"
		parent_window_name = "atm_window"
		visible = {
			has_country_flag = atm_gui_open
			check_variable = { atm_tab = 6 }
		}
		dirty = ROOT.atm_list_rev
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		effects = {
			atm_frefresh_btn_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					atm_recompute_scores = yes
					atm_build_flist = yes
				}
			}
			atm_fentry_pin_dec_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = -99 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = -99 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = -99 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 2 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 1 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 3 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 2 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 4 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 3 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 4 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 5 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 6 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 5 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 7 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 6 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 8 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 7 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 9 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 8 } }
					else = { set_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } }
					ROOT = { atm_settings_changed = yes atm_recompute_scores = yes }
				}
			}
			atm_fentry_pin_inc_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = -99 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 1 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 1 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 2 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 2 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 3 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 3 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 4 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 4 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 5 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 5 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 6 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 6 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 7 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 7 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 8 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 8 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 9 } }
					else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { atm_fpin = 9 } } set_variable = { atm_fpin = 9 } }
					else = { set_variable = { atm_fpin = 0 } }
					ROOT = { atm_settings_changed = yes atm_recompute_scores = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		dynamic_lists = {
			atm_faction_grid = {
				array = atm_flist
				change_scope = yes
				entry_container = "atm_faction_entry"
			}
		}
	}

	atm_decision_gui = {
		context_type = decision_category
		window_name = "atm_decision_panel"
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		effects = {
			atm_panel_open_click = {
				hidden_effect = {
					if = { limit = { has_country_flag = atm_gui_open } atm_close_window = yes }
					else = { atm_open_window = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
